mapper.select: SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, s.SEM_YEAR AS semYear, s.SEM_TERM AS semTerm FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) >= TRUNC(s.SEM_STR_DATE) ORDER BY s.SEM_YEAR DESC, CASE s.SEM_TERM WHEN 'WNT' THEN 4 WHEN 'SM2' THEN 3 WHEN 'SMR' THEN 2 WHEN 'SM1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, lc.LEC_COD_NAME, l.LEC_SECTION, l.LEC_ID
mapper.sql: FROM LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT a JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = a.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e ON e.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' WHERE a.LEC_ID = #{lecId}
mapper.select: SELECT a.LEC_ANN_ID AS noticeId, a.LEC_ANN_TITLE AS lecAnnTitle, a.LEC_ANN_CONTENT AS lecAnnContent, mb.MEMBER_NAME AS author, ( SELECT lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_ORG_URL FROM LMS_PROFILE_IMAGE lpi WHERE lpi.LMS_PRF_ID = l.LMS_PRF_ID AND lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_VAL_STATUS = 1 ORDER BY lpi.LMS_PRF_IMG_REG_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ) AS authorImageUrl, l.LMS_PRF_ID AS professorLmsPrfId, TO_CHAR(a.LEC_ANN_REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS lecAnnRegDate, TO_CHAR(a.LEC_ANN_REG_DATE, 'MM.DD') AS listDate FROM LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT a JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = a.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e ON e.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID AND e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' JOIN LMS_PROFILE pr ON pr.LMS_PRF_ID = l.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER mb ON mb.MEMBER_ID = pr.MEMBER_ID WHERE a.LEC_ID = #{lecId} ORDER BY a.LEC_ANN_REG_DATE DESC, a.LEC_ANN_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT att.LEC_ANN_ID AS noticeId, att.LEC_ANN_ATT_ID AS attachmentId, att.LEC_ANN_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, att.LEC_ANN_ATT_FIL_SIZE AS fileSize FROM LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT_ATTACHMENT att WHERE att.LEC_ANN_ID IN #{id} AND att.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' ORDER BY att.LEC_ANN_ID, att.LEC_ANN_ATT_REG_DATE, att.LEC_ANN_ATT_ID

SELECT att.LEC_ANN_ATT_TRN_FIL_NAME AS trnFileName, att.LEC_ANN_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName FROM LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT_ATTACHMENT att JOIN LECTURE_ANNOUNCEMENT a ON a.LEC_ANN_ID = att.LEC_ANN_ID JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = a.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e ON e.LEC_ID = l.LEC_ID WHERE att.LEC_ANN_ATT_ID = #{attachmentId} AND att.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' AND e.LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP'
